sources.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
sources.read_scope: Introduction; Section 3 and Algorithm 3.1; Theorems 3.1–3.4 and Section 4 opening. Full proof not independently reconstructed.

sources.limits: 以所读版本和评价协议为限；未复现原模型
